newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Feb. 25.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Feb. 25.

text.p: All major Mexican ports were reported open Tuesday as a Gulf of Mexico cold front from the weekend dissipated, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily meteorological report.
The report advised against sailing on the coasts of Oaxaca and Chiapas because of waves and high winds.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

A weak cold front descending on the northern Baja California peninsula causing waves of 10 to 20 knots (19 to 38 km/11 to 22 miles per hour) and wind gusts of up to 35 knots (66 km/37 miles per hour). Waves reported from six to nine feet high.
Stronger winds in the Gulf of Tehuantepec expected to diminish in the course of the day.

Winds along the coasts of Tamaulipas and the northern region of Veracruz. Clear skies along the coast with winds from east and southeast at 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 17 miles per hour) and waves three to five feet high.
Isolated winds and rains along coasts of Central America. Winds clocked at 10 to 15 knots per hour.
